AppSdm.Sdm.Shifts.ShiftModel.WorkDay.title: WorkDay
AppSdm.Sdm.Shifts.ShiftModel.WorkDay.description:
Describes a work day (calendar day).
Start and end times of the Work day depend on the ShiftBundle active on that day.
Start and end times need not be on the same calendar day.
